source.notes: CBSE competency-based education item bank for Maths Class 10 (September 2021, content created by the British Council for CBSE). It is a bank of practice items for teachers to build end-of-class tests and worksheets, not an examination paper, so there is no maximum mark or duration. Items are identified by their printed item identity (e.g. 'Maths10PS2'), used here as the question number; parts (a), (b)… of an item are separate entries, with any shared stem, source text or table repeated in each. Official answers come from each item's own mark scheme ('Answer' / 'Guidance') inside the same document, trimmed to value points; several mark-scheme equations extracted badly and are flagged. Where the printed item metadata and the marks printed next to the question disagree, the printed question marks are used and the conflict is flagged. Mathematical italic Unicode letters from the text layer were normalised to plain letters; powers, fractions and roots were rebuilt only where the layout was unambiguous (flagged). Tables were reconstructed inline as '[Table — …]' and flagged; figures are not reproduced. Items were written against the NCERT books current in 2021; chapters were mapped to the current (rationalised) NCERT Class 10 book as AI suggestions that must be confirmed. Items on topics removed from the current syllabus (decimal expansions of rational numbers, areas of similar triangles, Pythagoras theorem, area of a rhombus) have chapter null.
